Headline: #54 Cicero Temporary Reroute at Cicero/Harrison
ShortDescription: 54 Cicero buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near Cicero/Harrison.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#54 Cicero buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Cicero, Jackson, Laramie, Harrison, Cicero, and over the regular route due to street blockage near Cicero/Harrison.

Allow extra travel time.

Buses are rerouted due to a street blockage near Cicero/Harrison.
